title: Save up to 70% in Scott’s Black Friday sale
content:
Cyclist
Save up to 70% in Scott’s Black Friday sale

Black Friday month 2026 is well underway, with more and more cycling brands introducing big discounts across bikes, tech and clothing.

That includes Scott, which has Black Friday deals on its framesets and clothing as well as Syncros components.

Here’s what’s on offer:

Scott Black Friday cycling deals 2026

  • Scott Addict RC Ultimate HMX SL frameset – Was £4,899, now £4,409.10, save 10%
  • Scott Scale Gravel RC frameset – Was £2,299, now £2,069.10, save 10%
  • Scott Shield Light Sensitive sunglasses – Was £110, now £77, save 30%
  • Syncros Capital 1.0s 40 wheels – Was £1,649.99, now £1,154.99, save 30%
  • Syncros Capital 1.0s 60 wheels – Was £1,729.99, now £1,210.99, save 30%
  • Scott RC Weather Ultralight WB women’s jacket – Was £130.99, now £65.50, save 50%
  • Scott RC Weather Ultralight WB gilet – Was £89.99, now £45, save 50% (men’s / women’s)
  • Scott Commuter WB jacket – Was £134.99, now £67.50, save 50% (men’s / women’s)
  • Scott Explorair Light Dryo 2.5 Layer jacket – Was £165, now £82.50, save 50% (men’s / women’s)
  • Syncros Nanaimo 1200 front light – Was £94.99, now £28.50, save 70%
  • Syncros Pannier bag – Was £129.99, now £90.99, save 30%

Scott Addict RC Ultimate HMX SL frameset

£4,409.10 | Buy here

Starting at the highest end of Scott’s range, a pair of framesets have 10% off for Black Friday. The first of those is this Addict RC Ultimate HMX SL, the super-lightweight road frame that’s part of its ground-breaking Addict RC Ultimate Bike, which is the brand’s lightest ever production race bike.

Made with an HMX SL carbon frame and fork with ultra-thin tube walls, the frame weighs just 640g and the fork just 275g, making climbing a walk in the park. The frameset also includes the Syncros SP-R100-SL Carbon seatpost.

Scott Scale Gravel RC frameset

£2,069.10 | Buy here

If it’s a gravel bike frame you’re after. Scott has also discounted the Scale Gravel RC frameset. The Scale is an adventure-focused design, usually specced with flat handlebars for easier navigation of extreme terrain, but that doesn’t mean it’s slow.

The frame and fork weigh a combined 1.69kg, which includes Scott’s Advanced Shock & Standing Damping System for soaking up impact – something it shares with the brand’s hardtail mountain bikes. And there are also plenty of mounting points for loading up bikepacking bags.

Scott Shield Light Sensitive sunglasses

£77 | Buy here

Moving on from frames the savings increase, with 30% off the Scott Shield Light Sensitive sunglasses. The racing-oriented design of the Shield glasses is paired with photochromic lenses to adapt to changing light conditions, whether that be riding into the night, in tunnels or in low-light.

The curved shape of the big lens alongside the frameless design offers a huge field of vision, and they only weigh around 32g.

Syncros Capital 1.0s wheels

40mm: £1,154.99 | Buy here / 60mm: £1,210.99 | Buy here

Scott’s components brand Syncros is part of its Black Friday sale too, with 30% off the Capital 1.0s in both 40mm and 60mm. They feature the same carbon rim as the Capital SL monocoque wheels, but swap the integrated carbon spokes for DT Swiss stainless steel Aerolite spokes and also use DT Swiss 240 hubs.

With a 25mm internal width on both front and rear, they’re compatible with tyres ranging from 29mm to 50mm, so can be used for either road or gravel riding. Scott says the 40mm deep wheels weigh 1,335g and the 60s weigh 1,470g.

Scott RC Weather Ultralight WB women’s jacket

£65.50 | Buy here

Scott has also knocked 50% off a range of jackets, ideal for riding outside over the colder and wetter months. The first is the women’s RC Weather Ultralight WB jacket, which, as the name suggests, is lightweight as well as packable, for rides where it’s always wise to have a spare layer.

It’s made with Pertex Quantum Air fabric to be windproof and breathable, and has been designed to best fit in riding position, so flapping is kept to a minimum – the silicone bottom hem grip helps with that too.

Scott RC Weather Ultralight WB gilet

£45 | Buy men’s here | Buy women’s here

The exact same fabric and design has been used for the Scott RC Weather Ultralight WB gilet, which is half price in both men’s and women’s versions.

It offers the same weather protection as the jacket including water-repellency, but keeps the arms free for when you don’t need full coverage.

Scott Commuter WB jacket

£67.50 | Buy men’s here | Buy women’s here

For commuters or those looking for a looser fit cycling jacket, there is also 50% off the Scott Commuter WB jacket, which is still wind-resistant and packable, but has a more casual fit, plus reflective details and more pockets.

It’s made with PFC-free DURObreeze, DUROxpand and DUROzone materials for weather protection, breathability and stretch, and both men’s and women’s models are on offer for just under £68.

Scott Explorair Light Dryo 2.5 Layer jacket

£82.50 | Buy men’s here | Buy women’s here

For more serious weather protection, the Scott Explorair Light Dryo 2.5 Layer jacket is half price too. Made for all sorts of outdoor adventures, it has a loose fit and a hood, a two-way front zip, and it all packs down into the pocket.

The real winner is its weather-proof qualities though. It uses PFAS-free DRYOsphere 1.5L and DRYOzone technologies to provide waterproofing to 20,000mm and breathability to 20,000g/m2, giving you protection from the wind and rain without compromising sweat levels.

Syncros Nanaimo 1200 front light

£28.50 | Buy here

The biggest discount in the whole of Scott’s Black Friday 2026 sale is on the Syncros Nanaimo 1200 front light at a whopping 70% off.

That means for just £28.50 you can get your hands on a 1,200 lumen front light, which has two LEDs and five modes, including a light-sensitive mode that can switch between the most efficient see and be-seen lights depending on the conditions. Running time is up to 16 hours in the most efficient settings, and it’s ideal for use with Scott’s integrated cockpits but there are also a range of other mounts available.

Syncros Pannier bag

£90.99 | Buy here

Finally, for the adventurers and commuters, there’s a 30% saving to be had on the Syncros pannier bag. It’s a fully waterproof rear pannier with a roll-top closure to keep your stuff clean and dry.

It has a 30-litre volume, weighs 700g, has a Racktime hook top fixation system for extra security and is compatible with 9mm, 11mm and 14mm rack tubes.
